title: The Detection Cliff
description: How many audit probes it takes to catch a substituted model, as a function of how subtle the swap is. A 1/Δ² curve over real quantization accuracy gaps: a model swap is caught in a few hundred probes; FP8 needs ~150k and falls off the cliff into the economically-invisible zone.
controls: tap a substitution point to read its audit budget

dataSource.label: Quantization/substitution accuracy gaps: AImultiple, Qwen/Llama benchmarks
